steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the metadata for the application, including the app name and package namespace in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Set Up Android Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with correct SDK versions, Android Gradle Plugin, and Java 8 compilation standards.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate material themes, correct activity registration, orientation constraints, and namespace validation.

steps.title: Create Numeric Button Background
steps.description: Design custom XML drawable with rounded corners and click feedback for numeric buttons.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Background
steps.description: Design custom XML drawable with orange accents and click animations for arithmetic operators.

steps.title: Create Function Button Background
steps.description: Design custom XML drawable for specialized utility keys like Clear, Backspace, and Percentage.

steps.title: Create Screen Display Panel Styling
steps.description: Define a custom solid background style for the top display area of the calculator.

steps.title: Develop Premium Responsive Layout
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml using a matte black theme, clean typography, large displays, and perfectly scaled button layouts with dynamic weight factors.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Structure
steps.description: Establish class bindings, visual view linkages, and initialize the basic operational state fields in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Core Calculation Logic
steps.description: Develop calculation capabilities, handling input stacking, infix expression management, dynamic arithmetic operations, and precision float formatting.

steps.title: Add Memory & Specialized Handlers
steps.description: Integrate memory registers (MC, MR), square roots, percentages, and positive/negative toggles using strict Java 8 compliant anonymous inner class listeners.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute the build system compilation using Gradle 8.5 to assemble the fully optimized application package.
